tenglish: Ee saree/kurta lo chustunte traditional day ki brand ambassador la unnav.
english_meaning: In that saree/kurta you look like the brand ambassador of tradition.

tenglish: Phone screen kuda blush avtundi ee photo chusi.
english_meaning: Even the phone screen blushes seeing this photo.

tenglish: Aa smile ki copyright teesko, lekapothe chaala mandi flat aipotaru.
english_meaning: Take a copyright on that smile, or many will fall for it.

tenglish: Sunset baagundi kani, frame lo nuvvu undadam valla inka baagundi.
english_meaning: The sunset is nice, but you in the frame makes it nicer.

tenglish: Food chala tasty ga undi... kani company nenu unte inka baagundedi.
english_meaning: The food looks tasty... but it'd be better with me there.

tenglish: Mirror kuda lucky feel avtundi roju ninnu chustunnanduku.
english_meaning: Even the mirror feels lucky to see you every day.

tenglish: Aa kallatho chusthe evaraina surrender aipovalsinde.
english_meaning: Looking into those eyes, anyone would surrender.

tenglish: Black color neekosame invent chesinattu undi.
english_meaning: Black looks like it was invented just for you.

tenglish: Already itla unnav, inka workout chesthe maa paristhithi enti?
english_meaning: You already look like this; if you work out more, what happens to us?

tenglish: Poses kanna nee candid shots lo ne magic ekkuva untundi.
english_meaning: There's more magic in your candid shots than in posed ones.

tenglish: Nuvvu adigav kada, ipudu aakali kuda marchipoya.
english_meaning: You asked, so now I even forgot my hunger.

tenglish: Tinna, kani dessert laaga nee message kosam wait chestunna.
english_meaning: I ate, but I'm waiting for your message like dessert.

tenglish: Inka ledu, nuvvu tinipistava?
english_meaning: Not yet; will you feed me?

tenglish: Nuvvu tintene naaku kadupu nindinatlu untundi.
english_meaning: When you eat, I feel full too.

tenglish: Tinesa, kani nee voice vinte kani full satisfaction raadu.
english_meaning: I ate, but hearing your voice gives full satisfaction.

tenglish: It's okay, pedda celebrities busy ga ne untaru le.
english_meaning: It's okay, big celebrities are busy anyway.

tenglish: Parledu, nee message kosam entha sepu aina wait cheyochu.
english_meaning: No problem, I can wait as long as for your message.

tenglish: Late ga vachav kani, mood motham set chesav.
english_meaning: You came late but set my whole mood.

tenglish: Fine vesesta next time late chesthe - oka coffee treat ivvali.
english_meaning: I'll fine you next time you're late - a coffee treat.

tenglish: Nuvvu reply ivvadaniki late chesina, naa heart beat fast avvadaniki second kuda pattadu.
english_meaning: You were late to reply, but my heart took a second to race.

tenglish: Nuvvu doctor aa? Endukante ninnu chudagane naa BP perigipotundi.
english_meaning: Are you a doctor? Because my BP rises seeing you.

tenglish: Google Maps lo kuda nee heart ki route dorakatledu, koncham location share chestava?
english_meaning: Even Google Maps can't find the route to your heart; share location?

tenglish: Nuvvu Wi-Fi hotspot on chesava? Endukante automatic ga neeku attract aipotunna.
english_meaning: Did you turn on Wi-Fi hotspot? Because I'm auto-attracted to you.

tenglish: Naku swimming raadu, kani nee kallalo munigipovalani undi.
english_meaning: I can't swim, but I want to drown in your eyes.

tenglish: Police ki complaint ivvali ninnu... endukante naa nidra dongaatanam chesav.
english_meaning: I should complain to police... you stole my sleep.

tenglish: Nuvvu magnet aa? Nenu iron aa? Enduku ila lagutunnav?
english_meaning: Are you a magnet and I iron? Why am I stuck to you?

tenglish: Neeku Google pay chesta, koncham naa dream lo ki vastava?
english_meaning: I'll Google Pay you; come into my dreams a bit?

tenglish: Charging ledu phone lo, kani neetho matladutunte naaku full energy vastundi.
english_meaning: Phone has no charge, but talking to you gives full energy.

tenglish: Nuvvu magician aa? Ninnu chudagane naa problems anni disappear aipotunnai.
english_meaning: Are you a magician? My problems disappear seeing you.

tenglish: Exam lo kuda inni doubts raledu, kani nee gurinchi roju thoughts vastunnai.
english_meaning: Even in exams I had no doubts, but thoughts of you come daily.

tenglish: Roju lo best part enti ante, neetho matlade aa koncham time.
english_meaning: The best part of the day is that little time talking to you.

tenglish: Nuvvu navvithe chalu, aa roju motham worth anipistundi.
english_meaning: Your smile alone makes the whole day worth it.

tenglish: Chaala mandi parichayam ayyaru, kani neela evaru anipinchaledu.
english_meaning: I've met many, but no one feels like you.

tenglish: Nuvvu pakkana unte silence kuda music la vinipistundi.
english_meaning: With you beside me, silence sounds like music.

tenglish: Naa playlist lo favourite song kanna nee voice eh ekkuva istam.
english_meaning: I like your voice more than my favourite song.

tenglish: Ninnu kalisaka ardam ayyindi, perfection ante ento.
english_meaning: After meeting you I understood what perfection is.

tenglish: Enni messages vachina, nee notification kosame wait chestunta.
english_meaning: No matter how many messages, I wait for your notification.

tenglish: Nuvvu naa life lo ki vachaka, normal days kuda special ga maripoyai.
english_meaning: After you entered my life, even normal days became special.

tenglish: Ninnu chustunte time agipothe baagundu anipistundi.
english_meaning: I wish time would stop when I look at you.

tenglish: Simple ga cheppalante, naa happiness ki shortcut nuvve.
english_meaning: Simply put, you're the shortcut to my happiness.

tenglish: Chatting lo ne inta vibe unte, direct ga kalisthe ela untundo?
english_meaning: If the chat vibe is this good, how would meeting be?

tenglish: Ee weekend free na? Oka manchi coffee spot telusu, veldama?
english_meaning: Free this weekend? I know a good coffee spot; shall we go?

tenglish: Typing chesi chesi fingers noppi pudutunnai, call cheymantava?
english_meaning: My fingers hurt from typing; will you call?

tenglish: Long drive ki veldama? Music nenu pedatha, company nuvvu ivvu.
english_meaning: Shall we go on a long drive? I'll bring music, you bring company.

tenglish: Ninnu direct ga chudakunda ee week gadichela ledu, eppudu kaludham?
english_meaning: I couldn't get through this week without seeing you; when shall we meet?

tenglish: Ice cream treat naadi, time needi. Deal aa?
english_meaning: Ice cream treat is mine, time is yours. Deal?

tenglish: Oka 10 minutes kaludham ani start chesthe, 2 hours ela gadichipothayo teliyadu neetho.
english_meaning: If we meet for 10 minutes, 2 hours pass with you, I don't know how.

tenglish: Mana conversation ki next level ki teesukeldama? Dinner?
english_meaning: Shall we take our conversation to the next level? Dinner?

tenglish: Neeku bore kodithe cheppu, 15 minutes lo nee inti mundu unta.
english_meaning: If you're bored, tell me; I'll be at your door in 15 minutes.

tenglish: Phone screen meeda chusi chusi bore kottindi, real ga eppudu kanipistav?
english_meaning: I'm bored of seeing you on screen; when will you appear in real?
